title: schedule arc-tui heartbeat tick so HITL writes are not rejected
body_md: U-0005 + U-0001: bookie refuses HITL writes when no alive module implements verb; aliveness comes from ux_heartbeats.last_beat within STALE_SEC. bin/arc-tui.ts has a 'heartbeat' subcommand but no scheduler invokes it — grep finds zero callers. Wire a cron entry (or hygiene-tick hook) to run 'arc-tui heartbeat' every ~30s so the TUI module stays registered alive. Without this, all HITL prompts will trip the bookie no-alive-module fallback.
evidence_md: factory tick() beats ux_heartbeats.arc-tui every ~5s; smoke test confirmed row written age_sec=0; bun test bin/factory.test.ts 8/8 pass; commit e6854bf on PR #28
